cases.name: reachable-dashboard
cases.result: A synchronously created tab navigated to http://127.0.0.1:8092/ after the probe succeeded

cases.name: unreachable-dashboard
cases.action: Stop the isolated stub and click Cluster Management
cases.result: The temporary blank tab closed and the Hubble page remained usable
visibleMessages: Dashboard is unavailable. Check dashboard.address and service health.

cases.name: popup-blocked
cases.action: Temporarily force window.open() to return null through tab-scoped CDP, then click Cluster Management
cases.result: No Dashboard probe was issued and the page displayed one actionable message
visibleMessages: The Dashboard window was blocked. Allow pop-ups and retry.
